ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms invariants, an input domain and the derive-from-subject flag are declared; it does not run properties.
offer: State invariants independently of the function being tested and bound the generated input domain. Computing the expectation with the same implementation hides shared defects.

minimal.reason: State the invariants independently of the code under test. Invariants computed by the subject hide shared defects, so write them from the specification.

mid.reason: Bound the generated input domain. An unbounded domain explores nonsense, so declare the valid ranges.

maximal.reason: Set deriving expected values from the subject to false. Computing the expectation with the implementation proves nothing, so use an independent oracle.
